note: One-shot owner fix for the named volume elasticsearch_data (PR #33 review r1 R1-01): elasticsearch runs directly as the image's uid 101 (its entrypoint's chown+gosu step aborts under Rosetta), and a fresh bind volume under runtime/volumes/ belongs to the host user, so on a Linux/WSL host whose uid is not 101 Elasticsearch could not write its data directory. Same pattern as wiki_static_init (ADR-06): the elasticsearch:2 image as root with cap_drop ALL and only CAP_CHOWN (manifest/hardening.json), `chown 101:101 /data`, exit; elasticsearch waits with service_completed_successfully. No chmod (CAP_FOWNER would be needed); idempotent.
